jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(3)(D) (as amended, effective July 1, 2026) names the 'Lincoln Supervisory District' in the official inventory of supervisory unions and districts: the Lincoln School District is a single-town school district designated its own supervisory district under 16 V.S.A. section 261(c) in November 2022, with full operations from July 1, 2023, after the town's withdrawal from the Mount Abraham Unified School District.
Lincoln School District (official district website): the district operates the Lincoln Community School (K-6) and a grades 7-12 tuition/choice program.

A town district's school board is elected under 16 V.S.A. section 423 (three directors, or five as Lincoln's electorate has chosen); the board has five seats.

Lincoln School District Annual Meeting 2026 presentation: Article 8 elected, by Australian ballot on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, one School Director for three years and one School Director for two years (plus a one-year School Meeting Moderator). The two expiring directorships were Peg Sutlive's (the roster page printed her term expiring 3/2026) and Rob Backlund's.
Lincoln School District Board minutes, April 14, 2026: board members present include Peg Sutlive -- she held her seat through the March 2026 election.

Lincoln School District roster (live) lists Deborah Lubar as a current School Board member (dlubar@lincolnsd.org). She was seated at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting: Article 8 of that meeting elected two directors (three-year and two-year terms) for the seats whose terms expired -- Peg Sutlive's and Rob Backlund's; Sutlive held her seat (April 14, 2026 minutes) and Lubar appears as a board member in the March 24, 2026 minutes, taking the seat Backlund vacated. Recorded elected on that chain; which of the two 2026 terms (three-year or two-year) is hers is not published.

Lincoln School District Board minutes, March 24, 2026 (the first regular meeting after the annual meeting): board members present include Deborah Lubar; Backlund does not appear, and the district's live roster no longer lists him.

Lincoln School District Board agenda, January 27, 2026, lists Rob Backlund as a board member present; his term expired at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting, where one of the two directorships on the ballot was his seat. He does not appear in the March 24, 2026 minutes and the district's live roster no longer lists him, so this membership is ended in 2026. Deborah Lubar holds the seat now.

Lincoln School District Board minutes, March 24, 2026 (the first regular meeting after the annual meeting): board members present include Deborah Lubar; Backlund does not appear, and the district's live roster no longer lists him.
